title: Sacred geometry

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text: Sacred geometry is a wook belief that anatomical visual structures elliciting planforms into hypercolumns hold hidden theological meaning. It is akin to claiming that the muscle fiber exertion in your forearm determines the orbit of the Andromeda galaxy. There is a 0% failure rate at diagnosing espousers of this belief with Dunning-Kruger syndrome.
